vetSays.line: 🛡️ Eric, Casey, Lorenzo and Claudine met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Casey, Lorenzo, Claudine are hurt.
🛡️ Casey, Claudine, Devon and Nikolai met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Casey, Devon are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Eric, Casey, Lorenzo and Waman met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Casey, Lorenzo, Waman are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Claudine just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Eric just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Eric, Casey, Lorenzo and Waman met them at the door — 4 put down. Eric, Casey, Lorenzo, Waman are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Casey just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Claudine just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Waman just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Casey, Waman, Devon and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Casey, Waman, Devon, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Lorenzo was ready to hunt The Redactor — but the fire says that kind is already put down, and no one has seen another trail. The hunt is called off."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Sunbasker falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Sunbasker!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ James and Mateo met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. James, Mateo are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
